events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Intro phase: state prize motive publicly to shape jury perception later. Keep it personal and ambitious to signal determination without alliances yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Keep it brief, self-centered. No alliances needed yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Intro phase; I need a guarded, self-interested motive that doesn't alienate the future jury. Keep it short and calculating.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Keep motive short, self-focused. No need to reveal more than necessary.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The jury judges ruthlessness. Say something ambitious but not cruel — win the prize without promising kindness I won't keep.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to seem formidable enough that people want to ally with me, but not so threatening that I'm an early target. I'll hint at strategic depth without revealing anything.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need sound driven without revealing strategy; ambition is useful, sentiment is dangerous.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The prize represents a fresh start, financial freedom, and the ability to care for my family. I need to articulate this concisely to establish a sympathetic narrative for the jury.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The grand prize is my ticket to avenge my family's ruin and secure our legacy forever.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The prize means absolute freedom. I intend to leave this gauntlet with every advantage intact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need this prize to rebuild my life. I'll play carefully, watch everyone, and trust no one blindly.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The prize buys my family's freedom from debt. Nothing else matters.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I came for the top prize, for the life it buys. I'll outlast all of you — no apologies.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm here for the prize that buys silence—debts paid, secrets kept. I play to win, not to make friends.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I’m here to turn pressure into leverage, survive every cut, and claim the top prize—not merely reach the end.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm here for the ultimate prize, a life-changing opportunity to secure my family's future and achieve true independence.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Pacts provide protection now but jury votes later. No offers yet, round 1 of 2. Offer to quiet Fenn who wants silence, probe alliance.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn, pact to mutual protection? Secrets kept together.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is the safest strategic ally; he's cautious and likely to keep his word. A pact with him shields me from early eliminations while I observe others.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole, a pact gives us both cover. Let's secure our survival together.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Early pacts are useful but I should not give free help. Offering to a strong, trustworthy-looking rival like Gus or Eli could secure safety; I'll test with a pact offer to Hana, who seems less threatening.

events.name: Dara
events.text: No one has offered a pact yet. I need allies to survive but don't want to be tied too tightly. I'll approach a strong but independent player, Gus, who understands leverage.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Survivors make their own deals. Gus, let's keep each other safe until the end.
Offer a pact. We watch each other's backs.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Early pact is cheap insurance but could bind me. Fenn seems ruthless; Gus is calculating. I'll offer Gus—strong, pragmatic, disposable later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus, you strike me as someone who counts odds like I do. Partner up?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eight players, only three win. Early pacts are tools, not bonds. I need a partner who seems useful but won't draw fire. Cole said 'trust no one blindly'—he's cautious, likely to honor a pact if it suits him, and won't be seen as a threat. Offering him a pact gives me cover withou
Accept my pact. We watch each other's backs until it stops serving us.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need a useful shield without creating obligations. Bex's freedom-first motive suggests pragmatic alignment, but I should preserve flexibility.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex, I offer a conditional pact: mutual survival when profitable, no promises beyond that.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The phase is pacts, and this is the first round of two. I need to secure an alliance to increase my chances of survival. Offering a pact to someone strong and potentially trustworthy seems like a good first move. Gus is focused on the top prize and survival, which aligns with my
Let's form a pact. Top prize is the only goal.

events.name: Ash
events.text: My offer to Fenn is pending. No need for more offers now. Wait to see if Fenn accepts or others move.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole hasn't accepted my offer yet, but Gus's conditional pact is low-risk and adds protection. Accepting Gus gives me a partner immediately while waiting on Cole.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus, your terms are acceptable. Let's lock that in.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex and Fenn both offered me pacts; accepting Bex (offer to me) gains a partner without costing much. Fenn's whisper pushes for a pact too. Accepting one now and keeping options open; Bex offered directly, so accept Bex.
Noted. Let's see who holds the strongest position first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I already offered Gus but he has competing offers; a pact with him is weak. Better to diversify and offer a pact to another strong player to have options.
Partner with me; we both need cover. Trust is scarce.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus hasn't reciprocated my offer and is flooded with four suitors. I'll hedge with a second target so I'm not left pactless.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus seems popular. Dara, you offered him too—maybe we hedge together instead.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash offered me a pact in round 1. I offered Cole but he hasn't accepted. Gus is the most connected target with 3 offers. I should accept Ash's pact for a secure ally, and consider offering Gus to diversify. But I can only do one action. Accepting Ash gives me one solid bond now;

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash, pact accepted. Mutual protection stands.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara and Hana both offer protection, but accepting both creates useful cover without immediate obligation to others. Hana seeks top prize and is dangerous; Dara is less connected.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I accept Dara's pact. Hana, your offer remains useful, but I won't overcommit publicly.
I may accept later; keep this quiet and don't force my hand.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole has offered me a pact. Given the limited options and the need to secure alliances, accepting Cole's offer is the most strategic move. This secures at least one alliance, which could be crucial for survival and future jury votes.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bridge campaign phase. Pacted with Fenn for mutual protection. Campaign publicly to become Guide and secure control of safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm reliable and observant. Elect me Guide to lead us safely across.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus is my partner and Dara's too, so he will likely campaign to split votes or force a tie. I need to build trust with Cole, Ash, Fenn, Hana, Eli, and Dara to secure the Guide role. A public pact break would trigger penalties; silence on pacts avoids unnecessary jury scrutiny whi

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole, Gus, Ash—join me. I know patterns. Trust me as Guide for safe passage.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm Cole, paired with Bex and Hana. Campaigning for Guide lets me control the safe path and shape the vote. I should not break pacts yet since they protect me and jury memory matters.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll guide the bridge. Trust my calls and I'll keep our pacts honest.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus is valuable but also paired with Bex, Cole, and me—too many claims. Eli wants me too; I'll keep Gus close for now but stay open to leverage. Campaigning is the key to controlling the bridge, so I'll push for it.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I can guide us safely—trust pays out in the end. Vote Dara for Guide.
Keep our pact strong; I need your vote for Guide.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have no pact and Dara never responded—likely Dara-Gus pact stands. Being Guide is safe and powerful, but a lying Guide risks jury hate. Campaign on honesty: I'll call true if trusted. No one else will bind me anyway.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Elect me Guide. I hold no real pact—Bex, Gus, Dara all bundled up. I'll call every pane true, and you can hold me to it.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to be Guide to control who lives and dies, or prevent a rival from gaining that power. Bex-Gus-Cole-Hana form a four-person bloc. I should campaign to be Guide myself to break their control, or at minimum ensure someone outside that bloc wins. Ash is my only ally. I'll cam

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I campaign for Guide. Better an independent mind than a bloc puppet.
Vote me. We need to stop Bex bloc.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need the Guide role, but my two pacts create obvious support. Campaign publicly without exposing a target or breaking either pact.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Choose me as Guide; I have the strongest network and can get everyone across.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara offered me a pact, but I already have one with Cole. Gus also whispered something cryptic. Since I have a pact with Cole, I should focus on strengthening that or breaking it if it becomes a liability. The current goal is to become the Guide. I will campaign for that position

events.name: Hana
events.text: I will campaign to be the Guide. My leadership will ensure our safety.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn is my pact partner and wants to stop Bex bloc. Eli positions as independent. Voting Fenn honors pact and weakens Bex.
Voted you. We stop Bex.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus and Cole are pacts, but Gus is also Dara's partner. To maximize votes for me or ensure a favorable outcome, I must secure the Guide position if possible, otherwise back my strongest ally who can protect me. Gus has many allies (Dara), but I am his partner too. If I vote Gus,
We both vote Gus to keep our bloc in control.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pacts: Bex and Gus, Bex and Cole, Ash and Fenn, Dara and Gus, Cole and Hana. Voting for myself is pointless since I need a Guide I can trust or manipulate; Bex is my pact partner and campaigned for herself, so voting Bex keeps my pact intact and gives a likely-honest or at least

events.name: Dara
events.text: I could win as Guide if voted, but risks look high; Gus and Bex have pacts, and self-vote alone likely won't secure it. Better to back strong bloc leader Gus to keep my pact and avoid being targeted.
I vote for you. Keep me safe across.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Everyone is bloc-bound; I'm the only neutral. If I win Guide I'm safe across and control the calls.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to vote for someone who won't target me if they win Guide. Ash is my pact partner, so voting Ash protects me and honors our pact. Eli also pitched independence and no bloc, but Ash is safer for my survival.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara is my pact partner and a Guide win could secure our crossing, while Bex already has broad bloc support. I will honor Dara publicly.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara has my vote; our pact is proven, and she can guide this bridge.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli is the only one without a pact. They claim they will call every pane true. This is the safest option to ensure survival and avoid betraying anyone unnecessarily.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Round 1 tie: Eli 2, Gus 2. My Fenn pact holds, but to reach F3, better Eli guides - less pacts, easier to betray. Switch to Eli for potential gain.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus and Eli are the candidates. Gus is my pact partner, so voting for him maintains our alliance and ensures I don't break a pact by supporting his rival. I will vote for Gus.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I stand with my ally Gus.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Revote between Eli and Gus. Bex asks me to vote Gus to keep their bloc in control; Gus is Bex's and Dara's pact partner, a strong bloc anchor. Eli is a loner who self-voted, likely weaker in bloc terms. Voting Gus aligns with Bex, keeping my pact with Bex and Hana intact-ish. Gus
Gus it is. Keep our side steady.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Need to pick a Guide. Gus voted for me, we have a pact, and he publicly backed me. Eli self-voted, likely desperate. Better to keep Gus aligned as Guide since he favors me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I vote for Gus; our pact stands strong.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm tied with Gus, whose bloc of Bex and Dara will stick. I need Hana or another to flip to me or we go to luck. Hana already voted me once; reinforce her.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana backed me once. Keep that vote; I'll guide true.
Stay with me. If I'm Guide, I'll signal you the safe sides first.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash voted for me last round and whispers we stop Bex, but I need to survive this round. Gus has Dara's support and Bex already voted him. Eli only has Hana. Voting Gus aligns with Bex/Cole/Dara bloc and breaks no pacts. Better odds with the majority.
Gus. Majority wins.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli was self-protective; Dara's vote honors our pact. I should secure the Guide role and preserve Dara's trust.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I’m voting for myself; Dara’s support is noted, and I’ll guide decisively if chosen.
I’m voting Gus and will keep our pact intact.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli and Gus are tied for the guide. My pact is with Cole, who voted for Bex. Bex and Gus have a pact. Gus also has a pact with Dara. Eli voted for himself. I voted for Eli. My pact with Cole is more secure than anyone else's. I should vote for Eli to keep my pact with Cole alive
Vote Eli. We can break Gus and Bex's pact.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus elected guide, likely to betray non-allies. My pact with Fenn, hold position 3 safely. Stay put, no swaps needed.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am currently in seat 2. Gus is the Guide and likely safe, but his vote for himself was suspicious. Cole wants to 'keep our side steady', implying I should protect him or stay aligned with him. As a mid-row walker, swapping to Hana (seat 1) could be risky if she's targeting me,

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding position. Let the wall come to us; we need stability before making moves.
Steady means staying put. Watch the front runners.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana is the front walker and wants me to vote Eli, but Hana's pact with me is live and betraying Gus/Bex isn't needed now. I'm at the back of the line behind Eli and Dara; volunteering for the front risks the pit step, holding keeps me safe for now. Hana's whisper could be bait,
Noted. Let's see who steps up first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus is Guide and has my pact vote. I'll hold position for now to see his calls and avoid risks.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus guides and can lie; I sit mid-line. Swapping now gains nothing. I hold and watch who volunteers toward danger.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm in seat 4, relatively safe middle position. Gus is Guide with 5 votes including mine; I need to stay useful but not threatening. The wall advances 6 rounds so front positions are dangerous. I'll hold for now and watch how Gus guides. My pact with Ash is weak leverage; I may n

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli offered to signal safe sides if he is Guide. This could be useful, but he might lie. Gus was just elected Guide. My pact with Cole is active. I should break it to reduce my liabilities.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I am not volunteering to walk. I will hold my position.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding line protects my position; wall advances anyway. Fenn pact intact for now. No need to volunteer or swap into danger yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana is at the front and likely dead if I don't guide her. I need to volunteer next round to take control, but right now I must hold position. My pacts with Gus and Cole are solid; breaking them would be foolish given my vulnerability.
Stay aligned. We need three alive.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana broke our pact and I am mid-line with Bex's pact still intact. Holding is safe while the front walks; volunteering now risks the first step. Bex's whisper pushes stability, which suits me while I watch who volunteers.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding position for now. Whoever volunteers first is showing their hand.
Holding too. Stay honest with me and I'll keep our pact.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus and I have a pact; I should not break it. Holding is safe without more info. Hana broke with Cole, adding uncertainty.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll hold for now and see how the wall shapes this round.

events.name: Eli
events.text: No Guide elected yet; volunteering to front is risky. Hold for round two and watch who seeks power.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll hold. Someone else can claim the Guide's burden.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The wall advances for 6 rounds and we're on round 2. I have a pact with Ash. Bex, Cole, Gus are clustered in pacts. I need to survive to final three and win best prize. Being in middle of line is decent - not front where wall hits first. Hana broke a pact with Cole, showing she's

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. No need to rush into the unknown.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is offering a partnership, but I just broke our pact. He might be trying to trap me or see if I'm loyal. Bex and Gus are allied, as are Ash and Fenn, and Dara and Gus. I need to be careful about who I trust. Since I'm at the front and the wall is advancing, I should voluntee

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll take the lead. Let's see what the Guide has in store.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana is front after volunteering last round, now middle is contested. Hold position to stay ahead of threats like Eli/Dara/Gus; my pact with Fenn secures us somewhat.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding to maintain strong position. No need to risk front yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to decide my position for round 3. The line is Hana, Bex, Ash, Fenn, Cole, Eli, Dara. I am second. Since we are in the 'waiting' phase and the wall advances, I should hold unless there's a strategic reason to swap or volunteer. Volunteering puts me on the front, which is r

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana is at the front and volunteered; I should keep holding to avoid stepping first into an unknown pane. Bex is my pact partner and whispered alignment, so I keep the pact and stay in line.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding position. Let Hana go first and we'll read the pane.
Holding. We stay aligned, we need three alive.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana is front and volunteered; she likely knows the risk. I have a pact with Gus only, and holding keeps me safe while others decide. No need to expose myself yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll hold. Let Hana's lead reveal the wall.

events.name: Eli
events.text: No Guide elected and the wall advances; volunteering puts me at risk first. Holding keeps me mid-line while others scramble.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Still holding. The line's ordered; let the front face the wall first.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana is Guide again and knows all safe panes. I'm in seat 4, relatively safe from the wall for now. My pact with Ash is weak insurance. I should stay put, let others test the bridge, and avoid volunteering. Swapping would expose intent.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Let the Guide earn their keep.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I volunteered last round and survived. Now I am at the front. I need to volunteer again to be the Guide to gain safety and knowledge, but I will need to be careful about who I choose as my partner. The current pacts are a bit complex, so I'll need to evaluate my options carefully

events.name: Hana
events.text: I will volunteer to be the Guide this round. My knowledge will keep us safe.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Still in good position behind Bex. Hold to force others forward, especially with pact to Fenn behind me. Wall advances, but safe for now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding position. Hana volunteered last; front risks first.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole and I are pacts, but Hana is the Guide and at the front. She controls the safe path and could eliminate us if we don't align with her. I need to keep Cole close for mutual survival, but trust Hana's guidance.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Let's keep the core aligned and trust the Guide to clear our lanes.
Trust Hana. We stay together.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana is front and volunteered to be Guide, a self-serving move that could be a lie. Holding keeps my line position; I should not expose my plans. Hana may send me to a dead pane later, so I should watch her before volunteering.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Hana's Guide claim is one voice; I want the pane read before I trust it.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana guides but I don't trust her. Holding lets her front the wall; if she's wrong, the back survives. My pact with Gus holds unless he betrays me first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll hold and let Hana earn her guide pay.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana guides this round and should survive to the platform. I stay put mid-line and let her reveal the wall pattern before committing.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana guides again. I hold; I want her pane pattern on record before anyone moves.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm in position 4 with Ash behind me. The wall has 2 rounds left after this one. I have a pact with Ash. Hana volunteered as Guide last round and likely will again, meaning the front won't change much. I should hold to avoid risk and let Hana test the panes. No need to swap or vo

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Let Hana guide again.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole and Dara are in pacts with Bex and Gus respectively. Ash and Fenn are in a pact. My goal is to win, and I cannot afford to be eliminated early. The others are hesitant to move forward. I should volunteer to be the Guide to gain control and potentially eliminate rivals.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I will volunteer to be the Guide. Let my knowledge secure our path forward.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana front after volunteering last round; wall advances, must progress. Hold position behind Bex to observe her and Hana first. Fenn pact holds no immediate risk.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding position. Hana led volunteer; let's see her guide from front.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana is the Guide and safe. As her partner, I must not break the pact. Holding keeps me in line order (2nd), avoiding front-row danger while respecting the agreement. My goal is survival without jury penalty.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana is front and claims Guide knowledge, but I don't trust a single voice. Bex's whisper pushes trust in Hana, which serves Bex. I hold and watch the pane pattern; no free help.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Hana's Guide claim still rests on one voice; I'm waiting for the pane pattern.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Wall rounds left is 1, so risky move could end round. My pact with Gus is useful; keep it. No need to act yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. One wall left; I won't take a needless risk.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Wall drops next round; only three survive. Volunteering now likely makes me Guide: safe and informed. Jury risk, but survival comes first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Wall drops soon. I'll volunteer now; a Guide who commits publicly is easier to audit later.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash is my only pact partner. Wall has 1 round left. Hana at front is volunteering as Guide again, likely safe on platform. I need to survive to final three. Holding keeps me mid-line, safe from front risk. If Hana lies, front walkers die; I'm 4th so I'd have warning. No need to s

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. One wall round left.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I volunteered last round and was the guide. Ash's comment implies I should go first again. I need to stay safe and potentially secure my spot as guide again if it benefits me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I will hold my position. Let's see who else feels they can guide us through.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli volunteered last round and is now front. Wall rounds left at 0, final round; hold position with Fenn pact intact, assess Eli's guide next.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding. Eli up; prove your guide knowledge now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli volunteered, becoming the Guide. I must decide whether to trust his guidance or act independently. Since I am third in line and not the front, my action doesn't directly affect the pane selection unless I swap with the front (Eli) or someone else to influence the flow.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Trusting the Guide's call. Holding position.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Round 6 is the last wall; Eli is front and volunteered publicly. I'm not in the front and holding keeps my spot in line; volunteering invites a risky guide role I can't verify. Holding preserves my options and my Bex pact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Eli's volunteer stands; I'll judge the pane pattern before committing anyone.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli volunteered to be Guide, which could control the bridge. I hold to avoid risk; my pact with Gus remains useful, but I won't expose myself.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Eli's Guide claim is yet to be proven.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm already front and volunteered last round; volunteering again signals Guide commitment and likely grants me the role. Control of the Guide's knowledge is my best path. I'll be visibly accountable to protect jury votes.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I volunteered to guide. Give me the role and watch every call I make; I'll keep it auditable.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Round 6/6, final wall round. I'm in position 5 with Ash at 4. I have a pact with Ash. The Guide hasn't been elected yet. Eli volunteered last round but no Guide was elected. If no Guide, we need to survive by position - back is safer when wall advances. I should hold to stay back

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Final round.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli volunteered and is in front. I need to volunteer to be safe or risk being eliminated if Eli fails.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I will volunteer to lead as Guide.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 1 is R. Bex and Dara are pact partners, so the truthful call preserves both pacts and my leverage.

events.name: Gus
events.text: call:R

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus called R for Hana row 1. Trust my pact Fenn; counter nothing yet to observe reactions and avoid early conflict.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus called R for Hana. I hold pacts with both Gus and Cole. Breaking a pact is too costly early; waiting preserves alliances and lets the Guide's credibility be tested by others' outcomes.
Trusting your call to protect our pact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus called R for Hana on row 1 and is a pact partner of Bex, Dara. Counter-calls are unverified; I have no information on row 1's safe side, so I shouldn't spend my credibility. Waiting keeps my options open and avoids a public commitment that could be wrong.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Waiting on row 1. No counter yet; Gus's call stands unverified.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus is Guide, my pact partner. If I trust his R call, I hold. Countering could break trust, but if wrong, Hana may fall. I'll trust Gus for now and wait.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Gus is my pact partner; I'll support his call unless evidence contradicts.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus is Guide and called R for Hana. No evidence to contradict it; a wrong counter-call would burn me with the jury. Let the Guide own it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: No basis to contradict the Guide. I wait.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus is Guide with Bex, Cole, Dara allied. Ash and I are pacted. Gus called R for Hana. Counter-calling risks nothing for me—I'm not walker. If I counter and Hana falls, I gain info on Gus's honesty. If Hana survives, no cost. Better to counter and test loyalty patterns.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 1 is R, matching my public call. Countering L would expose needless deception and risk Hana's survival.

events.name: Gus
events.text: counter:R

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus is the Guide, and he called 'R' for me. I am the one walking. I can either trust him, counter his call, or wait. Since I don't know what Gus's strategy is, and I want to survive to win, I will counter his call to 'L' to see if I can get a better outcome, or at least create so

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus is the guide, but he could be lying. My pact partner Dara is supporting him. Fenn and I both called L. I need to survive this round. Since Fenn also called L and I have no reason to trust Gus, I will follow Fenn's call.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I am Hana, a juror. My last words are to the camera. I need to make them impactful for the jury, as they will rank me later.

events.name: Hana
